title: Study of Daraxonrasib and Daraxonrasib + GnP as First-Line Therapy in Patients with Metastatic Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (RASolute 303)
official: RASolute 303: A Phase 3 Global, Multicenter, Open-label, Randomized, 3-Arm Study of Daraxonrasib Monotherapy or Daraxonrasib Plus Gemcitabine and Nab-paclitaxel versus Gemcitabine and Nab-paclitaxel as a First-Line Treatment for Patients with Metastatic Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma
summary:
Main objective: To compare the effect of treatment with daraxonrasib monotherapy or daraxonrasib plus GnP versus GnP on: 
− PFS (per BICR)
− OS

interventions.name: Gemcitabin HEXAL 40 mg/ml Konzentrat zur Herstellung einer Infusionslösung
Abraxane 5 mg/ml powder for dispersion for infusion.
Gemcitabin Hikma 38 mg/ml Konzentrat zur Herstellung einer Infusionslösung

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. At least 18 years of age and has provided informed consent.
2. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 or 1.
3. Histologically or cytologically confirmed pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
4. Diagnosis of metastatic disease ≤ 6 weeks prior to informed consent.
5. Documented RAS mutation status, either mutant or wild-type.
6. Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1.
7. Adequate organ function (bone marrow, liver, kidney, coagulation).
8. Able to take oral medications.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Prior treatment with systemic anticancer therapy in metastatic or locally advanced setting or prior RAS-targeted therapy in any treatment setting.
2. Active or known history of untreated central nervous system metastatic disease.
3. Any conditions that may affect the ability to take or absorb study drug.
4. Major surgery within 28 days prior to randomization.
5. Patient is unable or unwilling to comply with protocol-required study visits or procedures.
